==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=ZeroLog&min=ZeroLog&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Plugins/ZeroLogTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=ZeroLog&min=ZeroLog&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using ZeroLog;

// Verify.ZeroLog: Captures what ZeroLog logs during a test into the recording, so the log lands in the snapshot.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.ZeroLog
// Note: Initialize() takes over ZeroLog's global LogManager: with no configuration it builds a
// test configuration, and with one already set it adds its appender to the existing root logger.
// Note: An existing configuration that keeps the default asynchronous appending records nothing,
// because the appender then runs outside the recording's AsyncLocal state. Configure
// AppendingStrategy.Synchronous before initializing (plan A14, retired by U11).
// Note: Entries are recorded under the name log, each keyed by its level, with the logger name
// beside it.
// Note: Every logging plugin records under log, so entries from two of them interleave and
// Recording.IgnoreNames cannot separate them (plan A12).
// Note: VerifyTests.ZeroLog.RecordingLogger is obsolete and now empty; use VerifyTests.Recording.
// Note: Anything logged outside a recording currently throws, so the logging has to sit between
// Recording.Start() and the verification (retired by U13).
public class ZeroLogTests
{
    // Everything logged between Recording.Start() and the verification is added to the snapshot
    // under the name log, so what the code logged is reviewed alongside what it returned.
    // Nothing about the logging has to be passed to Verify.
    [Fact]
    public Task Usage()
    {
        Recording.Start();

        var result = Method();

        return Verify(result);
    }

    // Stands in for code under test that logs. The logger is resolved the usual way: the
    // appender the plugin installed is what captures the messages.
    static string Method()
    {
        var logger = LogManager.GetLogger("Sample");
        logger.Error("The error");
        logger.Warn("The warning");
        return "Result";
    }
}
